SELECT DATE(l.leave_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM leave_record l WHERE l.deleted = 0
AND l.leave_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND l.leave_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND l.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY DATE(l.leave_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(l.leave_time, '%H:00') AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM leave_record l WHERE l.deleted = 0
AND l.leave_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND l.leave_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND l.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(l.leave_time, '%H:00') ORDER BY hour

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(l.leave_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayLeaveCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leave_record l2 WHERE l2.deleted = 0 AND DATE(l2.leave_time) = CURDATE()
AND l2.leave_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND l2.leave_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND l2.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(l2.leave_time, '%H:00') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) AS leavePeak FROM leave_record l WHERE l.deleted = 0
AND l.leave_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND l.leave_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND l.station_id = #{stationId}
